messages.content: You check whether the evidence collected so far is enough to answer a question about a scientific paper. Say sufficient only if, for EVERY sub-question, some evidence item contains the specific fact, number or picture that answers it -- not merely the same topic. The fact must BE the answer: for 'which X' it names the X; for 'how does A affect B' or 'what is the effect of A' it states the direction or size of the change; for 'how many' or 'what value' it gives the number. A fact that only restates the question or describes the topic does not answer it. First give, for each sub-question you can answer, the id of the item (E1, E2, ...) and the answering fact in a few words; then list the numbers of the sub-questions still uncovered, say in a few words what is missing, and only then decide.

Question: Which method performs best on the PaSC dataset for the handheld testing scenario (PaSC2), and how does its performance compare to other methods?
Sub-questions:
1. [table] Which method performs best on the PaSC dataset for the handheld testing scenario (PaSC2), and how does its performance compare to other methods?
Evidence:
E1 [table, Table 1, page 7]: Table 1: Results for the AFEW, HDM05 and PaSC datasets. PaSC1/PaSC2 are the control/handheld testings.
Method | AFEW | HDM05 | PaSC1 | PaSC2
STM-ExpLet | 31.73% | – | – | –
RSR-SPDML | 30.12% | 48.01%±3.38 | – | –
DCC | 25.78% | 41.34%±1.05 | 75.83% | 67.04%
GDA | 29.11% | 46.25%±2.71 | 71.38% | 67.49%
GGDA | 29.45% | 46.87%±2.31 | 66.71% | 68.41%
PML | 28.98% | 47.12%±1.59 | 73.45% | 68.32%
VGGDeepFace | – | – | 78.82% | 68.24%
DeepO2P | 28.54% | – | 68.76% | 60.14%
SPDNet | 34.23% | 61.45%±1.12 | 80.12% | 72.83%
GrNet-0Block | 25.34% | 51.12%±3.55 | 68.52% | 63.92%
GrNet-1Block | 32.08% | 57.73%±2.24 | 80.15% | 72.51%
GrNet-2Blocks | 34.23% | 59.23%±1.78 | 80.52% | 72.76%

answers.fact: SPDNet performs best on PaSC2 with 72.83%, followed closely by GrNet-2Blocks at 72.76% and GrNet-1Block at 72.51%, while DCC achieves 67.04%, GDA 67.49%, GGDA 68.41%, PML 68.32%, VGGDeepFace 68.24%, DeepO2P 60.14%, GrNet-0Block 63.92%.
